items.originalTitle: Anthropic valued at $2tn as shares begin trading after record-breaking IPO – business live
items.originalSummary: Rolling coverage of Anthropic’s IPO, and the latest economic and financial news Anthropic to begin public trading at $1.5tn valuation after largest ever IPO Outages, spies, and trillion-dollar IPOs: is this our AI future? – Stateside with Kai and Carter Anthropic needs to grow into its $1.5tn valuation, argues Kathleen Brooks, research director at XTB: Anthropic’s triumphant IPO and its trillion dollar plus valuation is more typical of a mature company that has a history of strong fundamentals. Anthropic could not be more different. It has generated strong revenue growth, but only in the short term, added to this, it is still unprofitable. Anthropic is another major tech company that requires investors to have a lot of faith about the future generation of revenues based on technology that will change the world. It seems like plenty are willing to give it that faith, and it is having a huge impact on the broader market today. Continue reading...

items.originalTitle: Anthropic keeps the AI party swinging, but the atmosphere is bubbly | Nils Pratley
items.originalSummary: Can the newly listed AI company really be worth $2tn? Anyone who remembers the late 1990s has good reason to ask Business live – latest updates Roll up, roll up, who wants to buy shares in a company whose technology “could pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity”, as the prospectus had it? Virtually everybody, as it turned out. Anthropic flew out of the blocks on its first day as a listed company . From the point of view of the promoters, the result was as good as it gets. The final pricing for the shares at $83 apiece was meaningfully higher than the indicated range of $70 to $78, but still left room for a big initial “pop”. There were positive vibes all round – especially for the battalion of investment banks collecting $550m of underwriting fees . Continue reading...
